label: GO step early in the episode, especially after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass; never at D2, essentially never at D1). Strongly gated by time in the episode: about 27% of GO steps in trials 0-9 are active, falling steadily to about 0 after trial 50, so it looks like a slow drift of the hidden state over the episode rather than a task variable. Within that early window it prefers GO steps after an unrewarded trial (prev_reward 0: 83% of mass). It also prefers moderately high value (7.7-8.1) and confident choices in either direction. The predicate (GO and trial < 10, or GO, trial < 40 and previous trial unrewarded) gets dev F1 0.78 and mass recall 0.94. The misses are low-magnitude GO steps after rewarded trials in trials 10-45. Most false positives are unrewarded GO steps in trials 20-40, where the unit has mostly decayed. Activation is largest in the first ~20 trials after an unrewarded trial. Uses only observed or episode-time variables, no future ones.
